title: Frozen
body:
Adds a snow dimension inhabited by coldeds some sort of frozen zombies that have a 1 in 3 chance of droping 1 diamond, it might seem like a good deal, however, the Frozen is inhabited by the Snowman, not your typical snowman...
### How to get to the Frozen:
1. Craft a Snow Fluff (craft in gallery images)
1. Make a portal frame out of stone diamond ore blocks
1. Light it up with the snow fluff (like for the nether portal)
### Mod additions:
- Snow fluff (item)
- Colded (entity)
- Snowman (entity)
- Frozen (dimension)
